releases.name: Gunboat God
releases.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

releases.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
releases.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the se-ries. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

releases.name: Astro Chef: Cosmic Kitchen
releases.summary:
Hunt. Cook. Sell. Upgrade. The galaxy is hungry!

The galaxy's favorite space diner is open… but the pantry's empty!

Astro Chef: Cosmic Kitchen is a cozy cooking adventure powered by fast, auto-attacking dungeon runs. Suit up as a bubble-helmeted astronaut chef, dive into monster-filled planets, and scoop up the ingredients your foes drop. Back in the kitchen, cook them in your cauldron and sell the dishes to a line of hungry aliens. Every coin goes into a giant Skill Tree, so each run hits harder, lasts longer, and pays more.

HUNT ON 4 PLANETS
Fight your way down 4 floors on each of Mushroom Planet, Aquarium Moon, Lava Forest, and Crystal Mine. Your main attack fires on its own: just move, aim, and mow through swarms of 13 monster types, from Spore Shrooms to Crystal Fairies. Deeper worlds bring toxic slime, biting flytraps, and falling crystals.

COOK UP 16 RECIPES
Find recipe scrolls in the dungeons, toss your haul into the cauldron, and serve up Spore Soup, Cockatrice Sushi, Galaxy Dumplings, Milky Way Ice Cream, and more. Add a pinch of seasoning and a dish sells for three times the price.

SERVE THE GALAXY
Alien customers line up at your counter. Stack servings into silver, gold, and cosmic dishes, chain sales combos, and watch your gold climb from a handful of coins into the trillions.

releases.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
releases.summary: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

releases.name: Spirit Crossing
releases.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

releases.name: The Lost Pit
releases.summary:
Embark on a perilous adventure deep in the heart of a wild forest. Run along ancient trails, cross crocodile-infested lakes, dodge underground scorpions, avoid venomous snakes, and swing across vines with perfectly timed jumps.

Put your reflexes to the test in a journey that demands skill and courage. Every obstacle you overcome brings you one step closer to proving you're a true explorer.

Can you survive the dangers of the jungle, collect the treasures, and complete the expedition before time runs out?

releases.name: Gnome House Heist - Burglin Simulator
releases.summary:
Small gnomes, big heists, and endless trouble inside unsuspecting human homes.

Step into a world of tiny troublemakers in Gnome House Heist - Burglin Simulator, a chaotic first-person cooperative adventure where mischievous gnomes sneak into human homes to steal valuables, complete missions, and cause mayhem. Team up with up to three friends and explore unpredictable houses filled with dangers, surprises, and opportunities for mischief.

Sneak through rooms, search for valuable objects, and complete randomly selected missions while avoiding humans and their pets. Keep an eye on your surroundings, manage noise levels, and use different routes to stay out of sight. Every house presents new challenges with randomized room layouts, objectives, and special level modifiers that keep each raid unpredictable.

Choose your approach and decide how to handle unexpected encounters. Use weapons, craftable traps, and items found throughout the environment to distract enemies, defend your team, or fight your way out when stealth is no longer an option.

Collect valuable loot, complete your objectives, and make it back to the portal before trouble catches up with you. Back at the hub, turn your findings into coins and spend them on new weapons, traps, and equipment to prepare for future raids.

Work together, explore every corner, and create unforgettable chaos in the homes of unsuspecting humans. In this world, being small doesn’t mean causing small problems!

releases.name: Boomerang King: Reloaded
releases.summary:
Master The Boomerang

Master the boomerang and slice your way through a colourful collection of fast-paced challenges!

Take aim, line up the perfect throw and send your boomerang slicing through fruit. Watch it carve through everything in its path before returning to your hand, and use skill and timing to complete each challenge.

Every stage brings a new layout to conquer, with increasingly difficult shots that put your accuracy to the test. Find the perfect angle, make every throw count and clear each stage in style!

Easy to pick up but challenging to master, get ready to throw, slice and become the ultimate boomerang master!

releases.name: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
releases.summary:
Take control of the team led by Saitama Prefecture, joined by allies from across Japan.

Stages are set in carefully selected "hometowns (jimoto)" from Japan's 47 prefectures! Navigate fields filled with familiar landmarks and local specialties!

The game rules are simple: jump and bounce to avoid falling off the stage and reach the goal.

It's a classic side-scrolling platformer. However, your character is completely limp, making even walking a challenge.

The key to the game is mastering its unique controls. Once you get the hang of it, you can even dash and perform big jumps. Give it a try!

releases.name: Needle in a Haystack
releases.summary: Start with a simple tool and a towering pile of hay. Collect, carry and sell material, then invest your earnings in equipment and build a factory that does the heavy lifting.Search for every needleUse your detector to track hidden needles, uncover them by hand or recover them through automated scanners, and bring them to the check-in desk.Build your own production linesConnect conveyors, storage and processing machines. Route power and water, watch material move through your factory, and solve bottlenecks as your operation grows.Turn hay into moreProcess raw material into bales, pellets, paper and eco-bricks. Research better tools and machinery, plan your next investment, and expand your warehouse across six successive loads.Work at your own pacePlay a single-player campaign focused on hands-on work and factory planning. Save your progress and return to the factory you built.

releases.name: Ex-Master, Zombie
releases.summary: Rise from the grave and reclaim what was lost. Explore a Metroidvania world, piece yourself back together, and unleash the true power of the Ex-Master. Death is not the end.

releases.name: Wild West Mining Simulator
releases.summary:
Dig Deep into the Wild West! Strike Gold and Discover Hidden Treasures! Build Your Own Mining Empire!

Step into the rugged world of the Wild West, where fortune awaits beneath the ground! Start your journey as a humble prospector and work your way up to becoming a legendary mining tycoon. Explore vast landscapes, discover hidden deposits of gold and valuable minerals, and dig your way through the earth in search of riches. Every discovery brings new opportunities to expand your mining operation and grow your fortune. Sell your precious resources, invest in better tools and powerful equipment, and unlock new areas filled with valuable treasures. Turn a small mining venture into a thriving business as you master the art of prospecting.

Key Features:
Dig for Treasure: Mine gold, ores, and valuable minerals hidden deep underground.
Explore the Wild West: Discover new locations, rich deposits, and hidden treasures.
Upgrade Your Equipment: Improve your mining tools to dig faster and reach deeper deposits.
Build Your Fortune: Sell collected resources, earn money, and reinvest in your mining business.
Expand Your Operations: Unlock new mining areas and take on bigger challenges.
Enjoy Satisfying Progression: Start with basic tools and gradually become a successful mining tycoon.

releases.name: Sort Them Cars: Sorting Simulator
releases.summary:
Fill the shelves with every model in its spot!

Clean up a messy room and make it perfect in this relaxing 3D puzzle game! Organize thousands of scattered toy cars and line them up neatly on shelves for a satisfying, stress-free experience.

Imagine walking into a messy toy store filled with piles of miniature cars. Your goal is to clean up the chaos by picking up the cars and putting them where they belong on the shelves. You'll group emergency vehicles together, organize race cars by color, and find rare vintage collectibles. You can take your time and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning a disaster into a perfectly organized display.

Key Features:
• Satisfying 3D Sorting: Have fun organizing tiny cars! Pick up and place miniature vehicles onto wooden shelves in a rewarding, hands-on way.
• Thousands of Cars: Collect and sort a huge variety of vehicles, from fire trucks and police cars to classic coupes and fast supercars.
• Organize Your Way: Arrange your collection however you like - sort them by type, job, or color to create the perfect display.
• Unlock Cool Upgrades: As you clean up the shop, you'll earn rewards like faster movement, tools to grab multiple cars at once, and more shelf space.
• Relaxing Experience: This is a stress-free game. There are no timers, no penalties, and no way to lose - just relax and organize at your own pace.

releases.name: XI O'Clock
releases.summary:
Can you escape the infinite time loop?

Enter a haunting first-person 3D psychological horror anomaly game where observation and memory are your only ways out.

In a quiet, endless hallway, your task is clear: move the clock from midnight to XI. Carefully inspect every detail of the corridor. If you spot an environmental, audio, or visual anomaly, pull the designated lever to move the clock forward one hour.

But beware: there is zero room for error. Pull the lever in a normal room, or miss a hidden anomaly, and the clock snaps back to midnight. This resets all your progress. Can you master the loop and survive until the final hour?

Key Features:
• First-Person Anomaly Spotting: Examine every corner of the hallway in detailed 3D. Search for eerie visual shifts, subtle sound changes, and physical abnormalities.
• The Race to Eleven: Pull the lever only when something is wrong. Each correct observation moves the clock one hour closer to 11:00 and your escape.
• Zero Margin for Error: One single mistake resets the clock back to midnight. Keep your calm as the anomalies become harder to detect with every passing hour.
• Liminal Psychological Horror: Feel spine-chilling tension from immersive audio and deep visuals.
• Randomized & Replayable: Encounter dozens of unique, randomized anomalies on every attempt. No two escape runs will ever be the same.

releases.name: Rooftop Parkour
releases.summary:
Run, jump, and glide across dangerous rooftops in Rooftop Parkour!

Dash past rivals, dodge obstacles, and use boost pads to keep your momentum. Master every leap, reach the finish line first, and race through exciting urban stages high above the city skyline.

Game Features:
- Fast-paced rooftop running action
- Challenging jumps, walls, fences, and boost pads
- Compete against multiple runners
- Stylish city environments and smooth movement
- Quick stages and addictive gameplay
- Simple controls with satisfying parkour flow

Can you take 1st place? Keep your speed, time your jumps, and conquer every rooftop!

releases.name: Mercenary Corps
releases.summary: Play as Raptor, an experienced mercenary hired to dismantle a network of arms smugglers and terrorists. Infiltrate outposts, eliminate key targets and sabotage enemy facilities.Experience the full campaign solo or in co-op, then enter competitive PvP. Unlock weapons for PvP through a detailed progression system and track your performance with online statistics.- Full campaign playable solo or in co-op.- PvP combat across 9 maps and 2 game modes.- 16 unlockable weapons.- Detailed progression system.- Online player statistics.- Dedicated server support.

releases.name: Mr Sticky's Ragdoll Launch
releases.summary:
Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles. Use the environment and your timing to swing, bounce and launch Mr. Sticky towards the finish.

Every level brings a new challenge, with clever obstacles and physics-based mechanics that will test your timing and precision. Keep an eye on the timer and try to complete each level as quickly as possible without losing control.

Collect all the stars and beat the clock to earn a 3-star rating! Can you conquer every level, set your fastest times and become a true ragdoll master?


Features:
* 32 levels
* Fun physics ragdoll mechanics
* Different traps to avoid
* Collect all 5 stars
* Easy to play hard to master

releases.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
releases.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

releases.name: Curse of Resthaven
releases.summary:
Take command of the cursed island colony of Resthaven after your niece disappears on the eve of a catastrophe. You must govern the town, allocate resources wisely, and decide who... or what... to trust.

Trade and haggle with visiting merchants, upgrade businesses, and interrogate townsfolk who guard their secrets closely. Every decision will impact the colony’s prosperity and unlock new leads, opportunities, and risks.

Multiple major narrative paths and randomized expeditions ensure that each playthrough exposes different pieces of the puzzle. Only by mastering the game’s systems and winning over the people of Resthaven can you hope to break the curse.

releases.name: Bumperhead
releases.summary:
Bumperhead is a 3D ragdoll physics crash comedy. You are the newest test subject for the Ministry of Questionable Safety, and your job is simple: climb into a ridiculous vehicle, speed down tracks full of ramps and hazards, and crash as spectacularly as possible.

Your rider is a floppy ragdoll with real physics. Every bump throws them from the seat, sends them tumbling and bending in all the wrong directions, while the vehicle falls apart piece by piece around them. It is all slapstick, with no blood, just bruises, bandages and very bad decisions.

releases.name: Fluffy Friends - Counting Farm
releases.summary:
15 preschool mini games with adorable farm animals!

Fluffy Friends is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting.
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated.
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest.

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

releases.name: 21 Lite
releases.summary:
Defeating the DEALER isn't difficult. Finish with a hand closer to 21 than the DEALER without going over. This is what the DEALER wants, but this is just the beginning. Maybe this could lead to something else entirely beyond the screen.

What have you done to yourself?

releases.name: Solitaire Companions - Dogs
releases.summary: Solitaire Companions - Dogs is a Puzzle game, developed and published by TB Games.

releases.name: Mr.Bump
releases.summary: EGGCONSOLE Mr.Bump PC-8801mkIISR

releases.name: Emoji Killer - Space Rampage
releases.summary:
Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge.

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

releases.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 1
releases.summary:
After rescuing the Cherubim, Mint, who you find passed out by the side of the road following her exile from Heaven, she moves in with you. Your close friendship naturally blossoms into something more, and she becomes your girlfriend. There's never a dull moment with the cheerful, naively honest, and rambunctious Mint by your side, which is only amplified when Lily, a half-demon and close friend of Mint's, suddenly shows up on your doorstep in all her over-the-top flirtatious glory.

Mint, the Cherubim, is eager to repay you for saving her life after she'd passed out from hunger. Unfortunately, she's pretty clumsy, and no matter what she cooks, it always comes out a charcoal brick. Welcome to your new, honeymoon-esque lovey-dovey life alongside the cat-eared Cherubim, Mint!

Follow Mint, a popular girl from the doujin circle "Animal Herb," as she stars in this brand new, heart-warmingly comedic game!

releases.name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
releases.summary:
A terrible drought plagues the Valley of Amara, and legend has it that only the scattered fire of the ancient Temple of the Sun can put an end to it. As the daughter of the temple’s guardian, Amara descends into its cursed depths to gather the fragmented sun—chamber by chamber—convinced that she is the heroine foretold by an ancient prophecy.

*Marble Saga: The Curse of the Temple of the Sun* is a narrative-driven take on the classic marble-shooting game. A chain of colored marbles winds along a twisting path toward the fiery heart of the temple. From an ancient, sundial-shaped launcher at the center of the chamber, aim and fire your own marbles; match three or more of the same color to break the chain and set it back. Power-ups add excitement to every session: explosive blasts, precision darts, a rainbow marble that connects with any color, a time-freeze ability, and a last-second reversal that pushes the chain back before it reaches the end. Complete the course to win, save your score, and uncover the rest of the story.

This is a complete, standalone adventure within the *Marble Saga* series, chronicling Amara’s journey across 150 hand-crafted levels. Each level features a unique environment with its own winding layout, a distinct aesthetic, and brand-new surprises. As you progress, the narrative deepens: what begins as a simple quest to rekindle the sun evolves into a tale that reveals the true heroes—and villains—behind the legend.

releases.name: Gennady
releases.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

releases.name: Samurai Love Ballad Song of Radiance
releases.summary: In the war-torn Sengoku Era. To save your brother's life, you go to serve at the castle. But...who would await you there but the samurai who would stop at nothing to rule Japan...! Though both of you know death is waiting... The love stories that will turn the tides of history...all start with you!

releases.name: UKKARIANS
releases.summary:
Was that “oops” really an accident?

Team up and take on a variety of minigames!
But watch out—there are traitors among your teammates, secretly trying to make the team fail.
The SHIKKARIANS are the cooperative team. Work together to reach the target score!
The UKKARIANS are the traitor team. Pretend to help while secretly getting in the way!
Reach the target score, and the SHIKKARIANS win!
Miss the target, and it’s time to vote on who the traitors are!
Unmask every traitor, and the SHIKKARIANS pull off a comeback victory. If even one goes undetected, the UKKARIANS win!
“Didn’t that move look a little suspicious?”
“No, I just messed up! Honest!”
Watch what everyone does during the minigames to uncover the traitors!
Great plays and suspicious slip-ups get everyone laughing and guessing.
Enjoy thrilling minigame showdowns that’ll have everyone saying “One more round!” every time you play!
〈UKKARIANS Features〉
◆ 12 minigames packed with “oops” moments!
- Block Tower:
Take turns dropping blocks and stacking them without toppling the tower! Could there be a reason behind that risky placement?
- Team Jump Rope:
One player swings the rope while the others jump! You’re trying to get in sync, but somehow the timing just isn’t right…
- Frantic Track Relay:

releases.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 2
releases.summary: Mint and her friends return in NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES 2! In order to save her family, a girl will defy fate itself and become the personification of miracles...

releases.name: Zomblox
releases.summary:
School's out. Zombies are in!

The school day has gone completely off the rails. Zombies have taken over the halls, your classmates have joined the undead, and even the teacher has become a monster. Grab your weapons and fight your way through the chaos before the whole school is lost.

Zomblox is a fast-paced first-person shooter packed with zombies, exploration, missions, secrets, and plenty of ridiculous surprises. Battle through classrooms, corridors, the swimming pool, ventilation shafts, storage rooms, and other hidden corners of the school as you search for your friends and uncover what happened.

Complete story missions, fight hordes of undead enemies, discover hidden areas, and keep an eye out for secrets tucked away throughout the school. Build up your collection of weapons and customize your arsenal with different weapon skins as you push deeper into zombie-infested territory.

Behind every door could be another group of zombies, a hidden passage, or something completely unexpected.

releases.name: How to Steal Your Best Friend's Girlfriend on Halloween
The Thaumaturge
releases.summary:
The Thaumaturge is an isometric, story-rich RPG with a unique take on turn-based combat, character development features, and investigation mechanics, facing you with morally ambiguous choices set in a world teeming with mysterious powers and strange ethereal beings called Salutors.

The year is 1905. Warsaw lives under the yoke of imperial Russian tsardom. Its inhabitants constitute a diverse group of different ancestries, views, and beliefs with often conflicting interests: Russian soldiers, Jewish merchants, Polish townspeople, and more. Despite the circumstances, the city is a buzzing metropolis, where one can attend a breathtaking party with the high society, and later get robbed in one of the dark alleys of the Praga district. A city of great hopes and dreams on one hand and dark desires on the other.

In this world, a force that cannot be ignored are Thaumaturges individuals versed in taming spirit-like beings called Salutors, used for manipulation of the temperaments and affinities of other people and even ultimately in combat. The devil is in the detail - only Thaumaturges are fully aware of the Salutors' nature and only they can perceive them in their true essence. Their capability to influence others significantly and demonstrably increases their ability to change the surrounding world - however, Thaumaturgy is a power that should be used with caution.

releases.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
releases.summary:
Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe. Feel the adrenaline of ski jumping as you compete on 18 varied hills, take part in World Cup, or create your own tournament tailored to your preferences.


Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

releases.name: Color Jelly
releases.summary:
Match colorful jelly pieces, create satisfying chains, and trigger explosive combos in a bright puzzle adventure. Plan your moves carefully, clear each goal, and keep the board from filling up.

Match, merge, and clear colorful jelly pieces in a bright and satisfying puzzle experience where every move can create a bigger chain reaction.
Place jelly blocks on the board, connect matching colors, and watch them combine as you work toward each level’s goals. Plan ahead carefully, because every new piece changes the board and a poorly placed move can quickly leave you without space.
Build longer chains, trigger powerful combos, and use helpful tools when the puzzle becomes especially tricky. Hammers can help remove troublesome pieces, while shuffling gives you another chance to reorganize the board and continue your strategy.
With cheerful visuals, simple rules, and increasingly challenging layouts, this is an easy game to pick up but a rewarding one to master.
Features:
- Colorful jelly-matching puzzle gameplay.
- Connect matching colors to clear pieces from the board.
- Create chains and satisfying combo reactions.
- Complete different color-based goals.
- Plan carefully to avoid filling the board.
- Use helpful boosters such as hammers and shuffles.
- Bright, playful presentation with simple controls.
- Increasingly challenging puzzles that test your planning and logic.

releases.name: Chrome Assassin
releases.summary:
Race through a hostile cyberpunk world in a fast-paced action platform where precision, reflexes and combat skills determine whether you survive.
Move across futuristic environments filled with hazards, enemies, and dangerous platforming sections. Jump between platforms, avoid deadly obstacles, and fight your way through each stage as the challenge steadily increase.
Every level demands quick and careful movement. Learn patterns, your enemies, and use your mobility to stay one step ahead of the threats surrounding you.
Step into a neon-lit future, push your skills to the limit, and prove that you can survive the machines and warriors stand in your way.

releases.name: Backrooms With Guns
releases.summary:
For once, you're the scariest thing in the Backrooms.

Everyone knows the rules of the Backrooms: don't make noise, don't look back, and run when something starts following you. Backrooms with Guns throws those rules out. You walk into the yellow halls armed, and the things that live there are about to learn what it's like to be hunted.

You start with a pistol and a knife. The pistol turns a crowd of crawlers into a wet mess on the carpet, and when the magazine runs dry in the middle of the swarm, the knife finishes what the bullets started. Running out of ammo here just means the killing gets personal.

Each round the horde comes back bigger and faster, and each round you leave more of them on the floor. Spend the cash they drop on a progression tree: harder hits, faster reloads, ammo and medkit drops, new combat styles, and heavier hardware like Uzis and the AA-12 shotgun for when one bullet per monster starts to feel too polite.

Pick one of four heroes and carve a path from the Backrooms through the Office, the Hotel, the Parking garage and the Pools. Every zone throws more at you, bosses included, and somewhere in the dark the Smiler is waiting. It has scared plenty of wanderers to death. It has never met someone with a shotgun.

By the end of a good run, the yellow walls aren't quite so yellow anymore.

releases.name: Hentai Protocol: Lesson Three
releases.summary:
Relaxing puzzles with cute anime girls.

Solve captivating puzzles featuring images of beautiful anime-style girls. With each image you complete, you'll unlock new ones, and the gradually increasing difficulty makes solving the puzzle a fascinating challenge. Intuitive touch controls create the feeling that you're actually touching every detail.

Soft and relaxing music will help you immerse yourself in the atmosphere, and after solving the puzzle, you can examine the image closely and admire every detail.

Features:

• Convenient one-handed play.
• Stylish anime images.
• Full immersion thanks to touch controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Relaxing music.

releases.name: Yummy Girl: Honey Bloom
releases.summary:
Relaxing puzzles with beautiful animated anime girls.

Assemble vibrant puzzles featuring animated anime-style images of beautiful girls. Each image is divided into small diamond-shaped pieces—find the right spot for each one and reconstruct the picture step by step.

Completing puzzles unlocks new images, while the gradually increasing difficulty keeps the gameplay engaging. Simple, intuitive controls make it easy to select a piece and place it in the correct position.

Once a puzzle is finished, the image comes to life, allowing you to admire the animated scene in full detail. Relaxing music enhances the atmosphere, letting you play at your own pace.

Features:

• Unique puzzles made of diamond-shaped pieces.
• Beautiful animated anime-style images of girls.
• New images unlocked as you progress.
• Simple and intuitive controls.
• Gradually increasing difficulty.
• Ability to view completed animated scenes.
• Soft, relaxing music.

releases.name: Hentai Fantasy Girls
releases.summary:
Piece together colourful puzzles featuring charming anime girls, unlock new artwork and enjoy beautiful moments.

Every puzzle piece brings you closer to a beautiful picture!

Enter a world of charming anime girls, vibrant illustrations and relaxing jigsaw puzzles. Fit the pieces together to reveal detailed artwork full of colour and atmosphere.

Meet captivating heroines in a variety of settings, from glowing city nights and cosy apartments to tropical waterfalls and stylish gyms. Every completed picture captures a different moment.

Take your time, enjoy the details and unlock new illustrations as you progress. Simple, intuitive controls make each puzzle a relaxing experience.

Features:
- Engaging jigsaw puzzles featuring beautiful anime girls.
- Colourful, detailed anime-inspired illustrations.
- City nights, cosy rooms, tropical landscapes and more.
- Charming heroines with unique looks and styles.
- Unlock new artwork by completing puzzles.
- Simple, intuitive controls.
- Relaxing gameplay and satisfying progression.
- Admire every completed picture in full detail.

Complete the puzzles and collect a gallery of beautiful moments!

releases.name: I Am Busy Chopping Trees
releases.summary:
Sorry, can't talk right now. There's a whole forest out there, and it isn't going to chop itself.

Everyone has that one excuse for ignoring their messages. Yours is a forest. I Am Busy Chopping Trees hands you an axe, a quiet valley and nothing urgent to do except swing.

Walk up to a pine, line up the blade and keep at it until the notch opens wide and the trunk gives way. Pine, birch, whatever is standing in front of you: if it has bark, it's a job, and every job ends with a crash and a pile of fresh logs at your feet.

Stack the logs onto your rail cart, roll down the tracks past the cliffs and the bushes, and honk the horn just because you can. At the sawmill the saw turns raw timber into cash, and the cash goes straight back into growing your little logging business, one shift at a time.

A good lumberjack also gives back. Switch to planting mode, put new trees in the ground and let the valley fill up again for the next round. Between shifts there's a log cabin, a water cooler and a view of the mountains that makes it very hard to remember what you were supposed to be doing instead.

The rest of the world can wait. You're busy.

releases.name: Shot Rider
releases.summary:
"SHOT RIDER" is a racing game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1985.
Drive your bike as the protagonist and crash into enemy riders to take them down as you race toward the finish line.
There are junctions along the stage where the route splits, allowing you to enjoy a variety of courses such as the highway, rocky, and snow courses depending on your choice.
Watch out for cars and obstacles, as crashing into them will significantly reduce your fuel.

releases.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
releases.summary:
A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop. The owner tells you the job is easy - all you have to do is water the plants, feed the pets, and stay the night. 

There's just one thing - do NOT, under any circumstances, turn off the lights.

releases.name: SuperMarket Mess!
releases.summary:
A cozy store organizing simulator for anyone seeking calm. Over 10,000 items await their place - collect plushies for tidy shelves as each store sparkles again.

Bring a messy Corner Shop and a big Supermarket back to order, one item at a time. Find where everything belongs, earn a plush for every full shelf and grow your skill tree. Easy to start, hard to put down.

Products are scattered across the floor, piled up in the aisles and hiding in quiet corners. It’s up to you to find them a home: fruit and veggies settle into baskets, frozen pizza goes back into the freezer, and every item finds its spot.

Begin in the Corner Shop, where 2,260 items fill 8 departments and 8 cute plushies wait to be found. The supermarket ups it to 8,023 products across 15 sections and 15 more plush friends. That’s 10,283 things to put right, and the quiet joy of seeing every shelf fall into place.

With charming characters, playful products and a warm, peaceful atmosphere, even the biggest mess feels like an invitation to unwind.

SKILL UPGRADES:
Give your inner neat freak a few superpowers. Pull in matching products with Magnetic Hands, highlight items by category and scan shelves to see what belongs where. Gain experience and unlock upgrades to carry more, reach further and move faster.

releases.name: Kaiju Girls: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
releases.summary:
Beat the kaiju. Trap the kaiju. Date the kaiju. Wait... the giant lizard is your girlfriend now?!

Giant monsters are flattening the city, and you're the only one with a trap big enough to stop them. The twist? Every kaiju you catch turns into a gorgeous anime girl who still remembers stomping on skyscrapers.

Fight them in turn-based battles, trap them before they wreck another block, and watch them transform. Then take them on dates and try not to get stepped on.

Meet a few of your catches:

♡ A fire-breathing reptile turned hot-headed beauty who melts down if you show up late.

♡ A giant moth girl drawn to every bright light in the city, including you.

♡ A deep-sea titan with an icy stare and a surprisingly soft side.

Other guys save the city. You get to date the things trying to destroy it. Ready?

releases.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys
releases.summary:
Cats have gotten angry about so many memes… now they’ve rebelled against the internet.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that turned them into icons.

Step into a chaotic clash where charm turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

releases.name: Gun Sprint
releases.summary:
A shooting run game! Use the recoil to fly forward! Blast your way to the goal!

Line up the enemies and take them all down with one shot for a Multi Kill!
Then take on Infinity Mode, trigger Fever Time, and break the records!

Fly too high and it'll be difficult to control. But stay too low and it'll be difficult to aim. Every shot sends your gun spinning through the air, so find the perfect timing to take down the enemies. But be careful: if your gun falls off the stage, it's over!

Take aim and snipe the Jackpot at the end for up to x1000 rewards! Unlock new guns, from pistols to bows and grenade launchers.

Think you've mastered the stages? Upgrade your gun in Infinity Mode, keep your combo going, and see how far you can go!

Features:
- Flip and launch your gun across every stage
- Take down multiple enemies in one shot to score Double or even Triple Kill!
- Snipe the Jackpot at the end for up to x1000 rewards
- Unlock a variety of guns
- Challenge yourself in Infinity Mode, upgrade your gun, and trigger Fever Time!
- Easy controls that anyone can pick up

Pick up your gun and see how far your timing can take you!

releases.name: MyRummy 2
releases.summary:
The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

Lay, combine, win!

Create runs and groups, match colors and numbers, and use your jokers at just the right moment.
Play with family and friends or take on the AI in solo matches. The first player to get rid of all their tiles wins!

• Easy to learn: Simple rules and instant fun
• Think ahead: Strategy, clever moves, and a little bit of luck
• Atmospheric settings: Choose your favorite place to play
• Play with family and friends – or challenge the AI
• Up to 4 players can compete against each other

releases.name: Kaiju Boys: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
releases.summary:
Fight him. Trap him. Date him. Hold on... you're going out with the thing that ate the harbor?!

Giant monsters are tearing the city apart, and you're the only one crazy enough to try catching them.

Plot twist: every kaiju you trap turns into a ridiculously hot anime boy who still has a habit of knocking over buildings.

Beat them in turn-based battles, trap them before they flatten another block, and watch the transformation happen. Then ask them out and hope he doesn't breathe fire on the waiter.

A few of the monsters waiting for you:

● A lava-blooded lizard turned hothead hunk who gets jealous enough to melt the pavement.

● A giant moth guy who can't resist a bright light, or a cute smile.

● A deep-sea titan with a cold stare, broad shoulders, and a soft spot he swears he doesn't have.
